Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the WebSurfer’s findings and incorrectly switched the identified telenovela from “Graduados” to “La Dueña,” falsely attributing the character Jimena Benítez/Patricia Longo and the March 12–December 19, 2012 Telefe dates to La Dueña. All cited sources (Wikipedia/DBpedia/Fandom) supported “Graduados,” so this erroneous leap led to the wrong final answer.
